def build_suffix_array(s):
    return sorted(range(len(s)), key=lambda i: s[i:])

def build_suffix_array_fast(s):
    n = len(s)
    sa = list(range(n))
    rank = [ord(c) for c in s]
    k = 1
    while k < n:
        key = lambda i: (rank[i], rank[i + k] if i + k < n else -1)
        sa.sort(key=key)
        new_rank = [0] * n
        for j in range(1, n):
            new_rank[sa[j]] = new_rank[sa[j-1]] + (key(sa[j]) != key(sa[j-1]))
        rank = new_rank
        k *= 2
    return sa

s = "banana"
sa = build_suffix_array_fast(s)
print(sa)
for i in sa:
    print(i, s[i:])
